description: Which instruments are wired to which board, keyed by the board's serial port. An Atmel-ICE is opened only by serial number: with two attached, 'the first one' can be the other bench's. never_open lists ports that are never a switchbox (tinyg_hil.switchbox refuses them and every bench port).

switchbox.note: The ESP8266 switchbox when it is not wired to a bench: used only by runs without --port. A bench it is wired to gets its own "switchbox": {"port": ...} entry instead.
